correctness.rationale: In logits dot x_i=Δ_i(p_{i-1}) has no dependence on x_i, so divergence identically zero. Mixed-equilibrium Jacobian weighted cyclic shift a_i=q_i(1−q_i)b_i, satisfies J^N=(product a_i)I, hence char λ^N−P. Root-angle counts give even-inverter 2floor((N−1)/4)+1 and odd-inverter 2floor((N+1)/4), with N=2/odd κ zero. For two players odd κ, derivative of K=|b2|F_{q1}(p1)+|b1|F_{q2}(p2), F_q=−q log p−(1−q)log(1−p), vanishes exactly; compact strictly convex levels are closed periodic orbits. Strict pure NE give diagonal Jacobian with negative entries. Independently counted positive-real-part roots for N=2..12 and both signs and verified the cyclic characteristic identity.
